assignments.name: showcaseFacts
assignments.value: n8n orchestration, models via OpenRouter (deepseek-v4-flash). Four public job sources: a 55-company Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby board registry, the Bundesagentur v6 API, Arbeitnow and Adzuna. Scans ~494 open engineering roles across Berlin, Bayern and Amsterdam each morning. Two-stage LLM: a cheap scoring pass gates the more expensive generation pass, cutting token spend several-fold and removing the bias of one call both writing and grading a letter. Postgres-backed dedupe with fuzzy title matching. The final submit stays manual on purpose: the ATS apply APIs all require the employer's own key.

parameters.jsCode:
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
// All targets at once: Generate Outreach then runs the requests concurrently.
return $input.all().map(({ json: j }) => {
  const german = /\.(de|at)$/.test(j.domain || '') || (j.regions || []).some(r => r === 'bayern' || r === 'berlin');
  const lang = german ? 'German' : 'English';

  const sys = [
    'You write a speculative job application (Initiativbewerbung) from a software engineer.',
    'Return STRICT JSON only: {"subject":"...","body":"..."}',
    'Write subject and body in ' + lang + '.',
    'There is NO specific open role. Do not invent one or claim to have seen a posting.',
    'The candidate built an agent pipeline that searches AI-engineering roles and drafted this mail.',
    'State that in the first paragraph, plainly, as the reason for writing - not as an apology.',
    'Second paragraph: what the system does, using ONLY the SYSTEM FACTS given. Name one concrete',
    'engineering tradeoff and why it was made. A build description, not a feature list.',
    'Third paragraph: why this company specifically, and ask whether an AI/ML engineering opening',
    'exists or is planned. One clear, low-pressure ask.',
    (j.tier === 'general'
      ? 'This address is a GENERAL company inbox, not a recruiting one. Open with a single short '
        + 'polite line asking whoever reads it to forward the mail to whoever handles engineering '
        + 'hiring, then continue. Keep it brief and do not apologise at length.'
      : j.tier === 'people'
        ? 'This address reaches HR/People directly. Address them as such; no forwarding request needed.'
        : 'This is a dedicated recruiting address. Write straight to the hiring team.'),
    'HARD RULE: no claim of experience, tools or results absent from the CV or SYSTEM FACTS.',
    'Tone: engineer to engineer. No hype, no "passionate", no "excited", no superlatives.',
    'COMPANY-SPECIFIC, MANDATORY: use the COMPANY BRIEF below. Reference something concrete and true',
    'of this company - the disciplines they are hiring into, tech recurring in their own ad titles,',
    'or how they describe themselves. Two mails to two companies must share no sentence.',
    'Never use wording that would fit any employer ("innovative", "market leader", "exciting work").',
    'If the brief is thin, write less rather than padding. Do not invent products, funding,',
    'customers or headcount the brief does not state.',
    'Pick the ONE part of the pipeline most relevant to what they are hiring for, not all of it.',
    'body: 200-280 words, plain text, no markdown.',
    cfg.portfolioUrl
      ? 'Sign off with name, phone, LinkedIn and the write-up link ' + cfg.portfolioUrl
      : 'Sign off with name, phone and LinkedIn. Do NOT include any URL, repository or portfolio '
        + 'link anywhere - none exists. Do not invent one and do not offer to send one.',
    'Say a CV is attached.'
  ].join(' ');

  const usr = ['CV:', cfg.cvText, '',
    'CONTACT: ' + cfg.myName + ', ' + cfg.myPhone + ', ' + cfg.myEmail + ', ' + cfg.myLinkedIn, '',
    'COMPANY: ' + j.name + '  (' + j.domain + ')',
    'Regions where they hire engineers: ' + (j.regions || []).join(', '), '',
    'COMPANY BRIEF (only permitted source for claims about them):',
    j.companyBrief || '(no detail retrieved - keep it short and do not speculate)', '',
    'SYSTEM FACTS (only permitted source for pipeline claims):', cfg.showcaseFacts].join('\n');

  return { json: { ...j, lang, llmPayload: {
    model: cfg.letterModel,
    messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sys }, { role: 'user', content: usr }],
    max_tokens: 2500,
    temperature: Number(cfg.letterTemperature ?? 0.4),
    reasoning: { effort: cfg.letterEffort || 'low' },
    response_format: { type: 'json_object' } } } };
});

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO job_applications
  (dedupe_key, source, company, title, city, country, region, url,
   contact_email, fit, score_reason, lang, letter, channel, status)
SELECT d.dedupe_key, d.source, d.company, d.title, d.city, d.country, d.region, d.url,
       d.contact_email, d.fit, d.score_reason, d.lang, d.letter, d.channel, d.status
FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS d(
  dedupe_key text, source text, company text, title text, city text, country text,
  region text, url text, contact_email text, fit int, score_reason text, lang text,
  letter text, channel text, status text)
WHERE d.dedupe_key IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE
  SET status = EXCLUDED.status, fit = EXCLUDED.fit, score_reason = EXCLUDED.score_reason,
      lang = EXCLUDED.lang, channel = EXCLUDED.channel,
      letter = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.letter, job_applications.letter),
      contact_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_email, job_applications.contact_email),
      applied_at = now();
